thesis: A professional-information franchise with rising ROIC (24.8%) and five-year-high margins trades below its own 5-year minimum on every earnings multiple and well below peers at a 7.66% FCF yield, pricing AI-disruption fears that its reported fundamentals do not yet show.
reason: Quality is rising, cash returns are strong and the mechanical bear value sits at the price, so the skew is favourable. The unexplained drawdown (likely AI-disruption fear), rising leverage, missing revenue-growth data and a stretched three-month rebound hold conviction at 4, not 5: standard volatility-scaled core size. Industrials stays well under the sector cap.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 20%, giving up most of the five-year rise from 18.6% to 24.8% and signalling moat erosion.
TTM FCF margin falls below 18%, under the 22-24% range it has held for five years, showing cash generation is weakening.
TTM gross margin falls below 70%, under the five-year low of 71.1%, signalling AI-driven price pressure on content and software.
Net debt/EBITDA rises above 3.0x (2.08x TTM now), showing capital returns are becoming balance-sheet risk.
